Julian Abraham has details. The leaked Classified Department of Defense memo, first reported by the Washington Post, has dominated conversations at the Halifax International Security Forum. Washington Governor Bob Ferguson is condemning the arrest of two people as they boarded an Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport yesterday. Masked who do not identify themselves during screaming individuals off a jetway as they're about to do something very ordinary in our country, board a flight. Homeland security says the operation targeted a man who overstayed his visa and alleges that a woman threw hot coffee at officers, Alaska Airlines says it has no advance notice and is reviewing whether proper procedures were followed, the Port of Seattle says it is in talks with Homeland Security. This is NPR News in Washington. The new Democratic-controlled Congress that convenes in January today hit a milestone of at least 258 seats, with confirmation that Democrat Chuck Hubbard defeated Republican Virginia Fox in North Carolina. We designed a task to enable her to sing a musical scale. We asked her to sing a typical major scale and we were able to decode all the notes that she sang with very high accuracy. The implant records her brain signals into a computer, which translates them into commands. The technology is still largely experimental and was presented at the Society for Neuroscience conference.
